newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria changes parameters of two T-bill issues.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria changes parameters of two T-bill issues.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry changed the parameters of two T-bill issues to be auctioned on Monday in line with preparations for the introduction of a restrictive monetary regime, a ministry official said.

"We brought settlement and maturity dates two days ahead and declined to set par value for the issues after the ministry decided to issue seven-day treasury bills every day to regulate excessive banks' liquidity," the official told Reuters. @

As a result of the ministry's decision the central bank said on Thursday that it would suspend from Monday its daily open market operations through daily revrepo auctions with repurchase of up to two days.
Under the initial offer the one-week discount issue had a par of eight billion levs. The four-week, also a discount one, had a par of 20 billion levs.
